why: Record 0076 found that the surface measurement covered 31 assemblies where the accepted measurement of the previous freeze covered 33, and that the diff artifact named neither of the two sides it compared. Both halves are answered here: the scope is restored and the comparison says what it compared.
cause: The earlier collection globbed '*/bin/Release/net9.0/*.dll'. ViciOne.ServiceBus.Analyzers builds only netstandard2.0 and ViciOne.ServiceBus.EntityFrameworkIntegration only netstandard2.1, so neither produced a net9.0 output and both fell out of the measurement silently. One of them, Analyzers, is a shipped package: it was packed by this freeze and no longer measured.

baseline.meaning: the accepted work package base, built from a detached worktree of that commit

current.meaning: the frozen candidate of record 0074, built from the working tree at that commit

collection.rule: one assembly per file name, taking the first available target framework in a fixed preference order
collection.excludes: reference assemblies under a ref/ directory

result.verdict: messaging surface unchanged, 0 testing changes, on the full 33 assembly scope

supersedes.note: Kept byte for byte. Its verdict was correct for the 31 assemblies it measured; it simply did not measure two of them.
